title: Metric Geometry of the Signature Group for $p$-Variation Rough Paths
summary: The signatures of $p$-rough paths form a subgroup of sufficiently high-level truncated tensor algebras, whose inverse limit is a subgroup of the full tensor algebra. For $p \geq 1$, we provide a top-down description of the signature group as the inverse limit of finite-dimensional Carnot--Carathéodory geometries in the $p$-variation setting. We show that every compatible choice of metrics induces a topological tree structure on the inverse-limit group, under which the signature group is not a topological group.
